charter: The cadences below are the desk's own stated commitments about how often each served surface moves. health.py grades the desk against them. A LATE or STALE row is a finding, printed — the same rule every other instrument on this site lives under. Editing a cadence here is a revision to a public commitment and rides the commit history like everything else.

states.EVENT: no cadence commitment; moves on events; age printed, never graded
states.NO-DATE: no internal date extractable and no git history — itself a finding
